settings.settings_source: windows: the cell (user 2026-11-23, 'the same 256 pairs per item'), read as the first min(256, |D|) windows of each item's D at every position. top_frac: the cell's top 1% most-needed. own_energy: chosen here as the share of M's own write energy an own space must hold; it is exact for every one-direction variable (rank 1 holds all of it) and stage 0 checks it. rank_rtol: numerical rank of the needed space, a fp64 tolerance. too_small: whip-lead's floor (2026-11-23, filed with E273). too_wide: a needed space whose null exceeds one half is not read. cache_batch, control, built: E268's (experiments/kstar_needed/results/predictions.json). head: whip-lead 2026-11-23, head (2, 4) at the head basis on E62's copy windows (E280's targets). The head scan uses E268's scan settings loaded live (4 derangements x 64, seed 268). panel_vpd_derangements: E268's first derangement only, a departure to fit the debug queue (plan section 3).

readings.strict: the frozen kept: commute.stand_in.explained(num, den) / dd per variable, pooled as explained_share over the read set N
readings.own: per variable |Delta P_O|^2 / |Delta|^2, O the fewest top eigen-directions of W_M^T W_M holding own_energy of its trace; pooled: numerators summed over N over sum dd over N
readings.needed: the same with S = span of O(u) and O(v) for every non-remainder v in the reference set R at u's site (VPD: the matrix; neuron basis: the layer's MLP for neurons and remainder, the layer's attention for heads), numerical rank at rank_rtol
readings.null: per variable dim S / d_out; pooled with the rotation share's weights
readings.rotation: pooled (needed - own) / (1 - own): the share of the change leaving the own space that lands in the needed space; its null (nu - dim O / d_out) / (1 - dim O / d_out), weighted the same
readings.sets: N: the ceil(top_frac n) changed members of K with most flips (saved scan); R: the ceil(top_frac n) members of K with most flips; ties to the lower index
readings.head24: head (2, 4) alone, on E62's 206 copy windows: strict and own share, and its flips of 256 pairs from needed_neurons.scan with pairs drawn within the copy windows

rules.R0: Stage 0 stops the job unless the do-nothing has every dd exactly 0.0, an empty changed read set, pooled shares 1.0 by convention, and every own space of R holding at least own_energy of its write (checked to 1e-12)
rules.R1: x2 runs first. At the neuron basis it stops the job unless every changed neuron in N has own share at least 1 - 1e-9 and the pooled own share is at least 0.99 (x2 scales down_proj columns, so each neuron's change lies along its own column)
rules.R2: On every item the job stops if any one-direction variable reads strict above own by more than 1e-9, or any variable reads own above needed by more than 1e-9 (both hold by construction)
rules.items: descriptive (card); no verdict on reuse under this reading

expected.stage0: do-nothing: dd max 0.0, read set empty, pooled shares 1.0, own spaces hold at least 0.99
expected.x2_x10_neurons: own share at least 1 - 1e-9 per changed neuron, pooled own at least 0.99; needed at least own
expected.x2_x10_vpd: needed share pooled at least the strict share (E268: E_b 0.761 over K); expected at least 0.9
expected.new_few_new_thin: needed share pooled at most 0.5; rotation share within 0.1 of its null, at both bases
